claims.statement: Richard K. Fox posted $1,000 with Harry Hill on 9 October 1882, offering to match Tom Allen against any man in America.

claims.statement: The proposed match was for $1,000 to $2,500 a side and the championship of the world, within 100 miles of New Orleans, to take place within three months of signing articles.

notes: Hint dated the Fox offer to 30 Oct 1882, but the dispatch is dated New York, October 9. Corrected to 9 Oct. The 'Sullivan' reference is garbled; the match terms are read from the printed figures. The cup inscription date is printed as May 2% Isv8 and only the month is taken from it.
